title: YURI Tools SDS-plus Concrete Drill Bit, 8mm Diameter, 160mm Total Length, 100mm Working Length, for AEG, Bosch, Hilti, Metabo
description: The YURI Tools 8mm Concrete Drill Bit is a reliable and robust drilling solution designed for heavy-duty masonry work. With a total length of 160mm and a working length of 100mm, this drill bit is perfectly sized for a wide range of concrete drilling tasks. The 8mm diameter ensures precise and clean holes in concrete, brick, and stone surfaces. Featuring an SDS-plus shank type, this drill bit offers a secure and firm fit, reducing slippage during operation and ensuring maximum drilling efficiency. It is compatible with popular power tool brands including AEG, Bosch, Hilti, and Metabo, making it a versatile addition to any toolkit. Manufactured to ISO 9001 standards, the YURI Tools drill bit guarantees consistent quality and durability. Whether you are a professional tradesperson or a DIY enthusiast, this concrete drill bit delivers dependable performance on tough surfaces. The spiral flute design aids in efficient debris removal, keeping your drilling smooth and uninterrupted. A must-have tool for any construction or renovation project.
